mission_08: The projection of b onto a is: proj_a(b) = (a.dot(b) / a.dot(a)) * a.
Gram-Schmidt: subtract projections onto all previous orthogonal vectors.
Normalize each orthogonal vector by dividing by its norm.
For orthonormal vectors, the projection matrix simplifies to P = E @ E.T.
Verify orthogonality by checking that all pairwise dot products are near zero.
The projection of v onto the subspace is P @ v.
